05-13-1588 is May 13, 1588.  
13 weeks + 7 days = 14 weeks = 98 days.  
Subtract 98 days from May 13, 1588.  
April has 30 days in 1588 (Gregorian).  
May 13 - 98 days:  
Back up 13 days to May 1.  
Back up 30 more days to April 1.  
Back up 30 more days to March 2 (1588 is a leap year, so March has 31 days).  
Remaining days: 98 - 13 - 30 - 30 = 25 days before March 2.  
February 1588 has 29 days (leap year).  
March 2 - 25 days: back 2 days to Feb 29, back 23 more days to Feb 6.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1588-02-06
